name: Robert D. Webb
tagline: Top rated Employee Benefits attorney in Dedham, Massachusetts
side_practice_areas: Employee Benefits, Employment & Labor, Mergers & Acquisitions
about: Robert D. Webb is a distinguished and formidable attorney at Chimento & Webb, P.C., a respected law firm based in Dedham, Massachusetts. With a practice built on meticulous preparation and decisive action, he provides clients with dedicated, results-focused representation in complex legal arenas. His decades of experience serve as a foundational differentiator in his market.

As a highly sought-after legal resource, Mr. Webb centers his practice on employment law, skillfully navigating high-stakes disputes and post-trial challenges to secure favorable outcomes for his clients. His exceptional capabilities extend to sophisticated compensation and benefit matters, where he regularly advises corporations and executives. This includes expertly handling sensitive regulatory actions like IRS audits and DOL investigations.

Mr. Webb is also adept at drafting and negotiating high-value executive employment agreements, change-in-control provisions and severance packages. Furthermore, his counsel is invaluable when addressing the critical employee benefit components embedded within corporate merger, acquisition and sale agreements. No matter the complexity of the case, he strives to provide the personalized attention and meticulous focus his clients deserve.

Mr. Webb’s commitment to the highest standards of the legal profession is affirmed by his esteemed peer rating. He is AV Preeminent* peer-review rated through Martindale-Hubbell, an achievement that highlights his professional excellence and respected standing among his peers.

Mr. Webb is admitted to practice law in Massachusetts, the primary geographic area he serves, and in New York. He laid the groundwork for his distinguished legal career by earning his Bachelor of Arts degree from Bowdoin College in 1984, followed by his Juris Doctor from Boston University School of Law in 1989.
